limitations: The exact fourth-power census and the extremal local Waring numbers are known; the claim is the uniform full even-exponent census and length distribution. Restricted to k even >=4 and prime two. Historical Waring 1977 full text was unavailable. No independent audit.
scientific_integrity: Every finite enumerative check is distinct from the symbolic proof. Prior maximum and fourth-power statements are credited; no priority or external validation beyond the stated inspections is asserted.
title: Uniform dyadic Waring-length laws for even powers
